body:
Founder real-time: "at some point ensure a full process sync" (unspecified scope, flagged
earlier). Interpreted concretely: check whether any currently-running service is on a binary
older than its own source, given several commits landed this session.

Traced package dependencies rather than guessed: internal/processor/fetch_clean.go (this
session's earlier XBRL ix:header fix, Apple #13361) is imported directly by cmd/processor AND
transitively by cmd/prwatch-body (via prwatch/crawler.go's own import) -- both were still running
binaries built well before that fix (processor: 2026-08-05, prwatch-body: 2026-08-05), meaning
the real SEC-filing/press-release cleaning bug fix was committed but not actually live yet.

Also checked internal/newssite/docindex (used by newssite -- already rebuilt this session -- and
signalapi, unaffected since RecentByType is additive) and internal/entitygraph (used by several
watchers, but only entity-graph itself -- already rebuilt -- calls the fixed
PublishObservation) -- neither needed further action.

Rebuilt bin/processor + bin/prwatch-body, restarted both services, confirmed healthy and actively
processing (real fetches within seconds of restart, per their own logs).
title: Process sync: rebuilt+restarted processor and prwatch-body to pick up the XBRL fix
